message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: The defendant falsified registration capital, used fraud to obtain business license, then repaid the person who fronted money. This is likely "诈骗" (fraud) or "虚假出具证明文件罪"? In Chinese criminal law, obtaining business license by false statements is "诈骗" (fraud) or "伪造、变造国家机关证件、印章罪"? Actually, providing false information to registration authority to obtain business license is "诈骗" (fraud) under article 266? Also could be "非法经营" but not. The act of obtaining registration capital by false statements is "诈骗" (fraud) because he deceived the registration authority to obtain license, causing economic loss? The registration authority may not suffer loss but the state loses. Could be "虚假陈述骗取行政许可罪" (Crime of obtaining administrative license by false statements) under Article 311 of Criminal Law (now 2021 amendment). The specific crime: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关证件、印章罪"? Not exactly. He didn't forge documents, just gave false statements. So the crime is "诈骗罪" (fraud) and possibly "非法占有他人财产罪"? He used 500 million capital that didn't exist, but he later repaid the 500 million to the person who fronted money, not to the state. The act of defrauding the registration authority is fraud. Also "挪用资金"? Not.

Thus likely only "诈骗罪". Also maybe "公司登记诈骗罪"? But standard is "诈骗罪". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
